text: おれが　つった　じまんの　さかなを　みろ！

structure.jp: じまんの　さかなを

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おれが　つった　じまんの　さかな
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing describes that thing. おれが つった じまんの さかな = 'the prize fish that I caught'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: The ろ ending is a blunt, rough order. みろ = 'look!'
